stringList.unequip_resisted.format: Notification. Quick flavor text; maximum 90 characters.
stringList.unequip_resisted.intent: Add quick flavor when locked armor resists a removal attempt.

unequip_resisted: The armor gives you a teasing squeeze and refuses to let go.
The device hums smugly—you’re not escaping that easily.
The armor tightens around your body, apparently amused by the attempt.
A playful pulse reminds you that the armor decides when it comes off.
